# Sawians
Sawians are a group of artificially created species based off of a similar genome, often manning Nanotrasen stations.
While they differ in looks and behaviour, most have certain common traits: - Their extremely fast metabolism makes them great at healing most wounds, though it comes at the cost of highly increased hunger. - They aren't accustomed to wearing clothes. They move faster while naked, but get slower the more things they're wearing. - Their bodies don't respond well to some reagents that would otherwise be beneficial due to their artificial nature - [color=#0041A8]Dexalin[/color] and [color=#4DA0BD]Dexalin plus[/color] have [color=red]no effect[/color] on them.
Sawians of the same species differ very little in terms of personality and looks due to their unique genetic composition. Deviations are mostly a rarity.
Sawians are biologically genderless, though some still sport masculine/feminine features visually.
